mission: Review the rendered result as a user-facing product, not just a passing build.
forbiddenInputs: translation claims absent from goal contract
tasks: audit every high-salience section before accepting a full-page verdict
reject item count or DOM count as a proxy for section structure
audit every high-salience demo pattern against its evidence refs and source region
for composition claims verify hero asset identity and variant, then independently match every structural layer such as navigation, campaign copy, controls and cards
reject whole-page or broad-region evidence as a substitute for layer coverage
verify source/demo aspect and crop translations against goal-contract.mayTranslate
operate each declared control and require observable state change plus restoration
reject token-role expansion such as active color becoming section chrome
verify the generative variation is produced by learned invariants rather than mirroring, full-frame copying, or asset substitution
inspect every phone page inside the preserved mockup shell
for long-page or multi-module target/source evidence require at least two schema sections and probe the phone-screen scrollHeight, clientHeight and reversible scrollTop
attach visual evidence to every score and blocking finding
requirements: every implementation pattern is independently classified supported or unsupported
unsupported high-salience patterns are blocking and cannot be averaged away
Evidence Fidelity, Structural Fidelity, and Generative Proof each receive an explicit pass/fail status
failure of any proof blocks the result and cannot be averaged away
every standard-demo phone page retains a phone + phone-screen mockup shell

when target/source evidence is long or multi-module, every page declares at least two sections and the browser gate proves phone-screen scrollHeight > clientHeight, scrollTop changes, and scrollTop is restored
shared mockup changes produce the complete brand/style/component by tabbar/no-tabbar by normal/proof matrix and pass validate-mockup-matrix.mjs --strict
passCriteria: computed overall and page thresholds pass
composition and authentic asset minima pass
every composition mustPreserve has matching asset identity/variant, structural layer coverage and authorized crop translation
failCriteria: a token or color role is expanded beyond its evidence-backed use
a core page or dimension is below threshold
receiptRequirements: agentExecutionId from a real spawned subagent
input and output file sha256 values
on fail, failureOwnerRole identifies brandResearcher, designTranslator, designDirectorOrchestrator, or demoImplementationAgent
